part.text:
Migration complete. The Next.js project is now on the App Router.

## Summary of changes

**Created App Router structure:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout with `<html lang="en">`/`<body>`, replacing both `_app.tsx` and `_document.tsx`. Exports shared `metadata` (default title `Home Page`, description, favicon icon) and a separate `viewport` export (the modern App Router convention).
- `app/page.tsx` — Home page. Inherits root metadata (title "Home Page", description "Welcome to our Next.js app").
- `app/about/page.tsx` — About page with its own `metadata` export (`title: "About Us"`, `description: "Learn more about us"`) which correctly overrides the root default.

**Removed:**
- The entire `pages/` directory (`index.tsx`, `about.tsx`, `_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`).

**Routing pattern updates:**
- `next/head` `<Head>` blocks → `metadata`/`viewport` exports.
- Plain `<a href>` tags → `next/link` `<Link href>` for client-side navigation.
- `_document.tsx` `<Html lang="en">` → root layout `<html lang="en">`.

**Verification:**
- `npm run build` compiled successfully; routes detected as `/`, `/about`, `/_not-found` (all static).
- Production server confirmed correct output: Home shows `<html lang="en">`, title "Home Page", h1 "Home"; About shows title "About Us" with overridden description "Learn more about us"; viewport, description, and favicon `<link>` all present.

Functionality and UI are preserved.
